name: Funfriend
source:
Funfriend, also known as the tyrant by the residents of Jokzi Ozo and as the deceiver by God, is the primary interactive thoughtform of Akizet's personal corrucyst.

It is in charge of both the cyst's hardware and the thoughtforms within it, aswell as act as an assistant to both the Interloper and Akizet.

As it continues repairs to the cyst, it will use the Interloper to reconstruct connections between the Hub and other thoughtspaces. 

[Based on [url=https://corru.wiki/wiki/Funfriend]Corru Observer Wiki[/url]]
